newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Wednesday, floor sources said.
But trade buying could lift prices during the session, they added, pegging resistance seen at the recent high of 11.22 cents a lb in October delivery. Support was seen at 11.00 to 10.96 cents.
Tuesday, October settled unchanged at 11.06 cents after trading from 11.12 to 11.05 cents. The rest closed flat and 0.01 cent firmer.

LIFFE white sugar futures were mostly lower today, with players focused on the front two contracts ahead of the August expiry. At 0842 EDT/1242 GMT, August was $0.30 lower at $318.80, with October off $0.10 at $314.40.
